def nested_for_break(flow, rows, condition):
    metadata = {}
    for _row in rows:
        if condition:
            metadata = flow.metadata
            break
    metadata["sandbox_run_id"] = "run-1"


async def nested_async_for_break(flow, rows, condition):
    metadata = {}
    async for _row in rows:
        if condition:
            metadata = flow.metadata
            break
    metadata["sandbox_token"] = "sandbox"


def nested_while_break(flow, condition, stop):
    metadata = {}
    while condition:
        if stop:
            metadata = flow.metadata
            break
    metadata["capture_body"] = True


def break_bypasses_for_else(flow, rows, condition):
    metadata = {}
    for _row in rows:
        if condition:
            metadata = flow.metadata
            break
    else:
        metadata = {}
    metadata["firewall_name"] = "github"


def break_alias_does_not_enter_for_else(flow, rows, condition):
    metadata = {}
    for _row in rows:
        if condition:
            metadata = flow.metadata
            break
    else:
        metadata["sandbox_run_id"] = "run-1"


def inner_break_stays_in_inner_loop(flow, outer_rows, inner_rows, condition):
    metadata = {}
    for _outer in outer_rows:
        for _inner in inner_rows:
            if condition:
                metadata = flow.metadata
                break
        metadata = {}
    metadata["original_url"] = "https://api.example.com"


def break_finally_rebinds(flow, rows, condition):
    metadata = {}
    for _row in rows:
        try:
            if condition:
                metadata = flow.metadata
                break
        finally:
            metadata = {}
    metadata["sandbox_run_id"] = "run-1"


def break_finally_aliases(flow, rows, condition):
    metadata = {}
    for _row in rows:
        try:
            if condition:
                break
        finally:
            metadata = flow.metadata
    metadata["firewall_permission"] = "read"


def finally_raises_after_break(flow, rows, condition):
    metadata = {}
    for _row in rows:
        try:
            if condition:
                metadata = flow.metadata
                break
        finally:
            metadata = {}
            raise RuntimeError()
    metadata["sandbox_run_id"] = "run-1"


def finally_reads_nested_break_alias(flow, rows, condition):
    for _row in rows:
        metadata = {}
        try:
            if condition:
                metadata = flow.metadata
                break
        finally:
            metadata["auth_cache_hit"] = True


def reachable_handler_break(flow, rows, condition):
    metadata = {}
    for _row in rows:
        try:
            operation()
        except Exception:
            if condition:
                metadata = flow.metadata
                break
    metadata["connector_diagnostic_slug"] = "handler"


def try_else_break(flow, rows, condition):
    metadata = {}
    for _row in rows:
        try:
            pass
        except Exception:
            pass
        else:
            if condition:
                metadata = flow.metadata
                break
    metadata["network_log_target"] = {}


def unreachable_handler_break_does_not_escape(flow, rows, condition):
    metadata = {}
    for _row in rows:
        try:
            pass
        except Exception:
            if condition:
                metadata = flow.metadata
                break
    metadata["sandbox_run_id"] = "run-1"


def break_bypasses_while_else(flow, condition, stop):
    metadata = {}
    while condition:
        if stop:
            metadata = flow.metadata
            break
    else:
        metadata = {}
    metadata["suppress_request_body_capture"] = True


def break_alias_does_not_enter_while_else(flow, condition, stop):
    metadata = {}
    while condition:
        if stop:
            metadata = flow.metadata
            break
    else:
        metadata["sandbox_run_id"] = "run-1"
